_readme: Optional live feed for the Leviathan panel. Drop values in and they appear in the
component panel and the top-right clock. Nothing here is required — with no live
data the panel shows the wiki envelope only, and every dashboard slot says 'no source'.
metrics: any of soc, v_batt, pv_w, load_w, gpu_w, gpu_c, wan, soc_12v, genset, wind_w,
dashboards: grafana / victron / proxmox URLs. Prefer the LOCAL addresses
(Modbus/MQTT on the Cerbo GX, or the Proxmox host) over any cloud portal —
a cloud dashboard stops working exactly when you need it.
Generate this file from the rig's own poller. Starting point:
Victron Cerbo GX -> local Modbus TCP or MQTT -> VictoriaMetrics -> Grafana
Proxmox -> its API -> the same metrics store
If the iframe stays blank, the target refused to be embedded; each dashboard slot has
an 'Open in new tab' link for that case.
